channel.title: Sanjay Sinha - Project Updates
channel.description: Latest project launches and major updates from Sanjay Sinha, Data Scientist specializing in Enterprise RAG systems and Azure AI.

item.title: Portfolio Website Launch
item.description: Launched professional portfolio showcasing Enterprise RAG systems, Azure OpenAI expertise, and production AI architectures. Featured projects: Air-Gapped RAG POC, EV Market Simulation, and DevOps Automation Agents.

item.title: Enterprise RAG System at Michelin
item.description: Leading architecture of Michelin's primary Enterprise RAG system using Azure OpenAI, LlamaCloud, and advanced model routing. Achieved 40% latency reduction through parallelized async execution and intelligent GPT-4o/GPT-4o-mini routing.

item.title: Air-Gapped RAG POC Released
item.description: Built fully offline, secure RAG system for sensitive infrastructure using Mistral, Phi-3-Vision, and Qdrant. Zero data leakage, 100% on-premise deployment with multi-modal document processing capabilities.

item.title: EV Market Simulation System
item.description: Comprehensive mathematical simulation system for French EV market combining ML forecasting with scenario modeling. Achieves 95% accuracy across 10+ market scenarios.

item.title: DevOps Automation Agents
item.description: Autonomous agents on Azure AI Foundry integrating Jira and Azure DevOps via REST APIs. Delivers 80% time savings with 24/7 automated issue tracking and pipeline monitoring.
